title: BNPL Platinum: How Your Variable APR Is Calculated (Indexes and Margins Explained)
summary: This document explains how BNPL Platinum’s variable APR is calculated using a reference index plus a fixed margin, then bounded to a specified program APR range. It also covers how index movements change the APR (typically starting new billing cycles) and outlines an example workflow.
